uploads.photoGuidance: HEIF/HEIC, JPEG/JPG or PNG. Up to {{max}} photos. Pick them straight off your phone or camera — large photos are optimized automatically and stored under 1 MB.
uploads.cameraGuidance: For smaller originals, use High Efficiency (HEIF/HEIC) on a supported iPhone or Android camera. File sizes vary; HEIC is converted to JPEG for browser compatibility.
uploads.documentGuidance: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC. We compress each file to under 1 MB.
uploads.pdfGuidance: Signed PDFs must already be under 1 MB, as compressing them breaks the signature. Documents are optional for publishing.

Seeker Free includes 15 contacts in total, each friend you refer who qualifies adds 15 more, and Seeker Plus or a paid owner plan gives unlimited contacts.
